executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $170.66 per resident day (43.7% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was -2.3% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $1,776,272, 25.3% of the $7,020,328 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $1,184,098, $28.78 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $598,314 (50.5%), allocated fringe $168,082 (14.2%), non-wage costs $417,702 (35.3%). Most food spending was a purchased (contracted) service ($81,956), so raw food per resident day is not comparable with homes that buy their own food.
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $426,016, $10.36 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $289,406 (67.9%), allocated fringe $81,302 (19.1%), non-wage costs $55,308 (13.0%).
Cost year 2025: laundry cost $318,455, $7.74 per resident day (Connecticut median $5.66). Wages $72,511 (22.8%), allocated fringe $20,370 (6.4%), non-wage costs $225,574 (70.8%).

Missing data: cost years 2016, 2017, 2018 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data); Cost year 2025 raw food is not used: not comparable (food bought by a contractor, lines do not add up, or missing).

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
